Maya (AM): Urgent POC blocker with Orion Health: streaming events cut mid-JSON behind Blue Coat. Demo tomorrow morning, request id r_0b12f.

Devon (SE): Are they using EventSource or fetch streams? Any sample of truncated payload?

Maya (AM): EventSource. Snippet: `data: {"report":"part1...` then connection closes, parse error client-side.

Ravi (Infra): Blue Coat often buffers when compression is enabled. Ask them to disable gzip for stream routes; also check idle timeout.

Marco (SRE): Quick server-side mitigation: enable short SSE heartbeats (comments) every 6s and add per-chunk debug header `X-RW-Seq`. Low-risk toggle we can canary.

Clara (Solutions): Demo fallback: use non-streaming complete endpoint for demo if needed. Also prepare Dedicated pricing note if they request it.

Devon (SE): I'll pull the gateway logs for r_0b12f and grep for `stream.write` lines and any `tcp_idle_close`.

ops-bot: Canary toggle `sse_keepalive=comments` enabled by Marco at 1732510200.

Maya (AM): Customer applied `disable gzip` and tried again; streaming now stable for 90s responses. They confirmed demo can proceed. Sending follow-up ops guide and pricing note.

Marco (SRE): Will add kb entry with nginx snippet (`proxy_buffering off`, `proxy_set_header Accept-Encoding ""`) and Blue Coat timeout guidance. Closing blocker unless new issues.
